name: darktrace-mcp
description: Investigate alerts, devices and incidents on your own Darktrace Threat Visualizer appliance through a local MCP server: read-only by default, previews for every change and human approval for critical actions.

appliance_url.title: Appliance URL
appliance_url.description: https://… of your Darktrace Threat Visualizer. The server connects only to this host, over TLS, with HMAC-signed requests.

public_token.title: Public API token
public_token.description: Public half of the API token pair (Darktrace: System Config → Settings → API Token). Kept in your operating system's credential store and sent only to the appliance.

private_token.title: Private API token
private_token.description: Private half of the API token pair. It signs every request and never leaves your machine except as a signature. Kept in your operating system's credential store.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.description: Comma list of read, sensitive, write, critical, or the word all. read: normal reads (default). sensitive: reads that can return raw traffic, email content or audit data. write: reversible changes, each with a dryRun preview. critical: Antigena actions, Watched Domains, subnets and tag deletion, each only after a preview, confirm:true and your approval dialog. Start with read.

acknowledge_sensitive_write.title: Acknowledge sensitive and write together
acknowledge_sensitive_write.description: Set to true only when profiles contains both sensitive and write (or all). Appliance content could then flow into free-text fields of writes, so the server refuses to start with that combination unless you acknowledge it here. Leave false otherwise.

date_format.title: Signature date format
date_format.description: compact (default) or spaced. Change it to spaced only if the appliance answers HTTP 400 to every signed request; the setup wizard of the npm package detects the right value.
